title: Six Sines
short_description: The challenge for this round is to make a track using Six Sines by baconpaul.
long_description: [Six Sines](https://github.com/baconpaul/six-sines) is a small synthesizer which explores audio rate inter-modulation of signals. Your challenge for this round is to **make a track using Six Sines**.  You can use as many instances of Six Sines as you like, with any effect, any sampler and any DAW as long as they are **free and open source**. You are not allowed to record audio intrumental or vocal performances. *Happy Music Making!*
